x-e-e1-01.title: プールの案内と合わない行動を見つけよう
x-e-e1-01.topic: 短いあいさつ・案内・文字で書いた絵
x-e-e1-01.goal: 案内の3つの決まりを、それぞれの人の状況と照らし合わせ、決まりに反する場合を選んだうえで、理由を英語で言います。
x-e-e1-01.material:

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = 大人)

4人がプールに行きます。
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.
